english.note: Choose this in writing, formal contexts, or when intentionally using the standard “good night”; everyday speech usually prefers 早唞.

examples.english: Colleagues, the meeting ends here; good night, everyone.
examples.traditional: 各位同事，會議到此結束，祝大家晚安。
